16.t: Working with data: comparing fuels from crude oil
q: Which fuel has the longest molecules?
Describe the link between chain length and boiling range.
Describe and explain the trend in soot.
Longer chains make more soot: they have more carbon and need more oxygen to burn completely.
Suggest why LPG is used for camping stoves and diesel for trucks.
LPG is a gas that lights easily and burns cleanly in a small stove. Diesel is a liquid that is easy to store safely in a large tank and gives lots of energy per litre.
